description.value:
You further evolve your ability to twist your chosen elements to your needs. You gain access to three of the following Metakinesis options of your choice, all of which modify your kinetic shape.

You can only use one Metakinesis option with your kinetic shape, unless otherwise noted.

Careful Kinesis

When you use your kinetic shape with an infusion that forces other creatures to make a Saving Throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the shape's full force. To do so, you spend 1 kinesis point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its Saving Throws against the blast and takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.

Distant Kinesis

When you use a kinetic shape, you can spend 1 kinesis point to double its range.

Empowered Kinesis

When you roll damage for your kinetic shape, you can spend 1 kinesis point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls.

You can use Empowered Kinesis even if you have already used a different Metakinesis option during the casting of the spell.

Extended Kinesis

When you use your kinetic shape with an infusion that makes it last more than 1 round, you can spend 1 kinesis point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

Heightened Kinesis

When you use your kinetic shape with an infusion that forces a creature to make a Saving Throw to resist its effects, you can spend 2 kinesis points to give one target of the shape Disadvantage on all its Saving Throws made against the effect.

Twinned Kinesis

When you use your kinetic shape with an infusion that doesn't have a range of self and is incapable of targeting more than one creature, you can spend 3 kinesis points to have it target a second creature within range as well.
